review.tagline: 21-lesson course on building generative AI apps in Python and TypeScript
review.summary: A Microsoft Cloud Advocates course of 21 lessons, each a README with a short video and code samples, split into "Learn" concept lessons and "Build" lessons. Topics include prompt engineering, text and chat apps, embeddings search, image generation, function calling, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, and small, Mistral and Meta models. Code targets Azure OpenAI, OpenAI API, Microsoft Foundry Models or Foundry Local.
review.audience: Developers new to building LLM apps who know basic Python or TypeScript
strengths: Build lessons ship code in both Python and TypeScript where possible
Covers RAG, function calling, agents, fine-tuning and security in one sequence
Lessons are independent, so you can start at any number
weaknesses: Samples assume Azure OpenAI, OpenAI API or Foundry access, which may need paid accounts
Several lessons list video as coming soon
Cloning includes 50+ translations, so sparse checkout is needed for a small download
GitHub Models lessons are tied to a service retiring end of July 2026
needs: Needs Azure OpenAI Service, OpenAI API, Microsoft Foundry Models, Foundry Local, GitHub account
Models: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry Models, Foundry Local, Hugging Face open models
